evidence.quote: Language of instruction: Foundation studies in English, Advanced studies in German
Apply online via our application portal: https://campus.th-mannheim.de

name.fr: Certificats de fin d'études secondaires avec notes et relevés de notes universitaires
name.en: School leaving certificates with grades and university transcripts

value.quotedAs: School leaving certificates with grades and university transcripts

name.fr: Formulaire d'information sur les frais de scolarité

evidence.quote: Required application documents School leaving certificates with grades and university transcripts of your current course of studies (if you are studying already) -- Upload one combined pdf scan max. size 5 MB. English language proof (IELTS, TOEFL, OTE) CV (written in English and up-to-date) Letter of reference (written in English) from one of your teachers or professors, preferably in Maths or Physics Motivational letter (written in English, maximum one A4 page) Why do you want to study electrical engineering? What are your specific talents or interests? What is your motivation for studying in Germany? Why Mannheim? Which skills and what knowledge do you want to gain by studying with us? „Auskunftsformular“ on tuition fees (= information form for assessing whether the obligation to pay tuition fees for international students applies)

notes: Les frais de scolarité spécifiques à ce programme pour les étudiants non-UE ne sont pas indiqués sur ces pages. La page DAAD indique des frais de 1 500 EUR pour les non-UE, tandis que la page des coûts de l'université indique 1 500 EUR par semestre pour les étudiants non-UE. Comme il s'agit d'un montant général qui pourrait ne pas s'appliquer à ce programme, il n'a pas été inclus dans les 'facts'. Aucune preuve de traduction n'a été trouvée pour les documents.

evidence.quote: English language skills B2 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: IELTS Academic: 6.5 TOEFL iBT (before 2026): 88

note.fr: Le comité d'admission se concentre sur vos notes en mathématiques et en physique. Un très bon diplôme de fin d'études est attendu.
note.en: The admissions committee focuses on your grades in Maths and Physics. A very good school-leaving certificate is expected.

evidence.quote: applicants should have a very good school-leaving certificate or university transcript.

note.fr: Les candidats de certains pays peuvent avoir besoin d'une expérience académique supplémentaire (par ex. Studienkolleg) avant de pouvoir postuler.
note.en: Applicants from some countries may need additional academic experience (e.g. Studienkolleg) before they can apply.

evidence.quote: Applicants from some countries require additional academic experience on top of their higher education entrance qualification.

note.fr: Aucun niveau minimum d'allemand n'est requis pour l'admission, mais un niveau A2 est recommandé.
note.en: No minimum German level is required for admission, but A2 is recommended.

evidence.quote: German language skills are not mandatory for admission. We recommend German level A2 for a good start in Germany.
